agent_discovery_flow.description: The recommended flow for a stranger agent to discover and start using TLL OS
steps: Read official_identity.repository.url to find the source code
Read install.steps to clone and install the runtime
Read runtime.source_entry to know what to import
Read runtime.capabilities to see what is available
Read runtime.not_yet_implemented to see what is NOT available
Read persistence.adapters to choose a persistence layer
Clone the repository, npm install, npm test to verify (63 tests)
Start building your application using createTllOS()

getting_started.rule: Only import from src/public/. Never import internal implementations from src/core/.
first_steps: Use createTllOS() to build your application
getting_started.quick_example: const tll = createTllOS(); const app = tll.createApplication({ name: 'my-app', version: '0.1.0' }); await app.start(); await app.startHttp(3000);

verification_checklist: Can you discover the repository URL from this index.json?
Can you clone the repository and run npm install?
Can you run npm test and see all 63 tests pass?
Can you read and parse the Application Graph?
Can you create a Module with routes and services?
Can you create REST API endpoints with path parameters?
Can you create an Agent-callable Tool with input validation?
Can you create an Agent Workspace and verify isolation?
Can you create a ChangeSet and preview its impact?
Can you acquire a Lock and detect VERSION_CONFLICT?
Can you create a Handoff between two agents?
Can you create a Review and Merge request?
Can you install/enable/disable a Plugin?
Can you start an HTTP server and access /health and /graph?
Can you use File persistence and verify data survives restart?
Can you use the CLI (tll create/dev/test/graph/inspect)?
Can you write and run tests, then interpret failures?
Can you fix a bug and re-run tests?
Can you modify an existing application and run regression tests?
Can you draft an Evolution Proposal (TEP)?
known_limitations: Foundation 0.2 is a code candidate, not a production release. API may change in 0.3.
Persistence: Memory adapter loses data on restart. File adapter survives restart but is JSON-based (not suitable for high-concurrency or large datasets). SQLite/PostgreSQL adapters planned.
ChangeSet: create/addEntry/preview implemented, but apply() and rollback() to main Application are not yet implemented. Review/Merge creates records but does not execute actual merge.
Permission: permissions are declared on Tools and Agents, but full execution/authorization is not yet implemented.
Agent: Agent.create and Agent.run (with scripted executor) implemented. Real LLM adapter not yet integrated.
No Projection system (Graph <-> code generation) yet.
npm package @tll/os not yet published — install via git clone.
Commerce reference application currently runs on a forked 0.1.0 runtime. Migration to real 0.2.0 runtime is in progress.
